capital.evidence_quote: Asunción is the capital and largest city of the Republic of Paraguay

currency.evidence_quote: The Paraguayan Guaraní (PYG, ₲) is the official currency of Paraguay

sources.title: Dirección de Meteorología e Hidrología Paraguay

timezone.evidence_quote: Paraguay Standard Time operates on UTC-4, advancing to UTC-3 in summer months

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential alternating current across Paraguay is supplied at 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national electrical power grid operates at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: European standard Type C round two-pin outlets are universal in Paraguay

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency police response across all departments

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 141 for SEME emergency medical dispatch and hospital transport

sources.title: Cuerpo de Bomberos Voluntarios del Paraguay (CBVP)

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 132 for emergency fire and rescue operations

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Policía Urbana y Turística patrols historic Asunción and Jesuit missions reachable via 911

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Paraguay genel olarak huzurlu bir seyahat ülkesidir; Brezilya sınırındaki Ciudad del Este bölgesinde standart dikkat gereklidir.
advisory_headline.en: Paraguay is generally peaceful; exercise normal precautions, with vigilance around Ciudad del Este border zones.
advisory_headline.de: Paraguay ist weitgehend friedlich; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen, erhöht im Grenzgebiet Ciudad del Este.
advisory_headline.ru: Парагвай в целом спокоен; соблюдайте обычные правила, проявляя бдительность в приграничном Сьюдад-дель-Эсте.
advisory_headline.es: Paraguay es generalmente tranquilo; aplican precauciones normales con cautela en Ciudad del Este.

regional_warnings.area: Amambay, San Pedro, and Canindeyú border departments

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Paraguay reach approximately 30.2 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds across Asunción measure 74.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Tigo and Claro provide 4G tourist SIMs with rapid registration in Asunción (ASU airport). Drinking iced tereré (herbal yerba mate with cold water) is the defining social ritual across the country.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Passport presentation is standard for prepaid SIM card activation

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (approx. 88%) with deep bilingual Spanish and Guaraní national identity
religion.evidence_quote: Catholicism is the predominant faith; Guaraní is co-official and spoken by over 80% of the population

festivals.value: Virgen de Caacupé Pilgrimage (December 8), San Juan Ára fire-walking festival, Asunción Carnival
festivals.evidence_quote: The annual pilgrimage to the Basilica of Caacupé is the largest religious event in Paraguay

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Never refuse an invitation to share tereré (cold yerba mate) as it is considered an important gesture of friendship and warmth. Police checkpoints outside major cities are routine; carry passport and international driving permit.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Tereré culture (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage) is the core social connector in Paraguay

tipping.value: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants and cafés. Tipping taxi drivers is not customary, though rounding up the meter is appreciated.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% tip is standard in restaurants when service is not included
